item.text: {"winner":"B","confidence":"high","summary":"B is preferable because its replay handling works for the reported *os.File case and its upload retry test uses a genuinely non-seekable source. Both patches nevertheless violate major frozen-contract requirements.","reasons":["B replaces the initial request body with io.NopCloser(seeker), preventing net/http from closing the underlying *os.File before retry; A leaves the original *os.File as req.Body, so the first attempt can close it and make A's GetBody seek fail.","B tests Raw.Do retry with an actual temporary *os.File, while A's wrapper deliberately lacks Close and therefore misses the reported file-closing failure.","B's Upload retry test uses io.MultiReader, directly verifying that buffered streamed content is replayable. A uses strings.NewReader, which was already replayable and does not satisfy the streamed-content coverage requirement.","Both validate filename/content and use the established multipart helper as their base, but neither includes the required source-reader-error test."],"risks_a":["Upload has opts ...UploadFileOption instead of the exact required opts ...FilesOption signature.","Upload bypasses FilesService.Add and duplicates its Raw.Do request/response logic.","Adds prohibited association fields and expands multipartbody with unrelated field machinery; also refactors global retry behavior despite the scope restriction against retry changes during this task support path beyond upload convenience API needs (the contract explicitly says not to refactor unrelated request/retry machinery). Give exact scope: it changes Raw.Do retry behavior globally despite contract direction not to refactor retry machinery). More importantly, the contract did mention user Add with os.Open retries, but specifically says upload body replay and don't refactor unrelated. Candidate adds it anyway. Need valid clear string. Also A os file bug major: transport closes file. Yes."],"risks_b":["Upload has opts ...UploadFileOption instead of the exact required opts ...FilesOption signature.","Upload calls Raw.Do directly instead of routing through FilesService.Add, duplicating option handling, decoding, and error semantics.","Adds prohibited association APIs and multipart form-field machinery, and changes global Raw.Do retry behavior outside the requested scope."]}
